constraints_addressed: Adoption in other repositories: Pipeline engine distributed as a standalone CLI package (`uv tool install agentic-pipeline`); adopting repositories vendor only human-owned configuration files (`.agentic/` or root `policy/`, `pipeline/`, `schemas/`), preserving the immutable policy guarantee and frozen digest verification without source duplication.

Cross-platform OS portability: Preserves strict isolation requirements across Linux, macOS, and Windows. Uses native unprivileged user namespace bubblewrap (bwrap) on Linux; provides an OCI container/WSL2 virtualization backend on macOS and Windows to enforce mandatory filesystem bind isolation, network blackholing, and tmpfs credential separation.

Configuration TUI: Terminal-based interface using Python standard library primitives to inspect available models via `models discover`, validate agent mappings via `models test`, and output staging candidate diffs (`model_registry.candidate.yaml`) for human PR review without direct policy mutation.

Unattended CI integration: Supports Jenkins and GitLab CI pipelines by persisting `.runs/<id>` run state and provenance logs via native CI artifact passing, pausing at manual approval gates for cryptographically signed SSH approvals (`ssh-keygen -Y sign`) verified offline against `policy/approvers.yaml`.

Subscription-only compliance: Resolves the unattended CI interactive login conflict by supporting dedicated self-hosted runners pre-authenticated with vendor tools or a decoupled hybrid workflow where cloud design stages run on developer workstations and unattended build stages run in CI.
Minimal dependency footprint: Introduces zero third-party packages to the trusted pipeline base, relying entirely on the Python standard library and platform-native tools.

data_flows.purpose: Transmits requirements specifications and design proposals to Claude CLI (`claude -p`) under interactive personal subscription.
Transmits requirements specifications and design proposals to Gemini CLI (`agy -p`) under interactive personal subscription.
Transmits confidential source tree and test files to local build worker (llama-server/Ollama) with network access disabled.
Persists run directories, provenance logs, sealed manifests, and signed approvals between pipeline stages via Jenkins/GitLab CI artifact storage.
